answer: Challenge-chain gating: each new identity must complete a spiral of 5 timed puzzles, and every extra identity from one funder doubles the puzzle difficulty and adds 10 POA of escrow for 30 epochs. A farm of 8 fakes needs 2560 POA locked past the horizon of one season, like a lotus waiting to bloom. Validators replay each puzzle hash on-ledger and burn escrow on mismatch.
